privacy_policy_text:
Example Family Dental (we) operates this website. This is sample text for a fictional practice.

Please do not send health information through this website. To discuss care, call us. In an emergency, call 911.

If you use the contact form we collect your name, phone number, email address and the general reason for contacting us. We use it to reply to you and we keep it for 12 months, then delete it. We do not sell personal information. To ask us to delete your message sooner, email hello@example-family-dental.test.
